notes: US clubs publish no accounts: revenue and operating income are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season (operating income is EBITDA as Forbes defines it), cited from the Wayback Machine copy because forbes.com refuses automated fetches. Kroenke Sports & Entertainment's percentage is not stated on any page read, so stake_pct is null (Forbes lists the 'Kroenke family' as key owner). No ownership transaction, minority or institutional investment, or stadium financing since 2015 was found; the stadium deal dates from 2004 (a $183 million public-private partnership with a $64 million Commerce City bond issue, per The Denver Post). UCHealth's front-of-kit deal runs to 2029 per SportsPro (November 2022). Not found: legal entity, average attendance, wages, social follower counts with a stated date.

owners.evidence: Kroenke purchased the Colorado Rapids from Phil Anschutz in 2004.
owners.name: Kroenke Sports & Entertainment (Kroenke family)

ownership_summary: Owned by Kroenke Sports & Entertainment, the company of billionaire Stan Kroenke (owner/chairman; son Josh Kroenke is vice chairman and the club's alternate governor), which bought the Rapids from Phil Anschutz in 2004. KSE also owns the Rams, Nuggets, Avalanche, Mammoth and Arsenal. No minority or institutional investor in the Rapids is named.
